components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54% .16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search field
components.css: .ds-search { min-height: 2.25rem; width: 8rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); background: var(--color-paper-2); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0 .75rem; font-size: .875rem; transition: width 150ms; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-fog); } .ds-search:focus { width: 12rem; border-color: var(--color-teal); outline: none; }

components.name: Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font: 500 .875rem var(--font-plex-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--color-fog); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--color-teal); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54% .16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Article card
components.description: Editorial story with category and title.
components.html:
Tecnología

Una historia de tecnología
components.css: .ds-card a { color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--color-paper-2); } .ds-label { color: var(--color-teal); font: 500 .72rem var(--font-plex-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: .75rem 0 .375rem; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: var(--font-space-grotesk), sans-serif; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-card a:hover h3 { color: var(--color-teal); } .ds-card a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54% .16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Archive filter
components.description: Bordered year filter with an active teal state.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; padding: .5rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-teal); background: var(--color-teal-soft); color: var(--color-teal); font: .72rem var(--font-plex-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: .09em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-filter:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54% .16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Affiliate action
components.css: .ds-affiliate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); font: 600 .875rem var(--font-plex-sans), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 100ms; } .ds-affiliate:hover { background: var(--color-teal); } .ds-affiliate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(54% .16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A clear, editorial interface gives articles and headlines the leading role. A light paper-like canvas, dark ink, concise rules, and a restrained teal accent create the character of a contemporary technology publication.

Components are practical and restrained. The system relies on hierarchy, typography, and spacing rather than decorative depth; functional controls and overlays may have subtle lift.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial hierarchy with strong display headlines and compact metadata.
Paper, ink, and teal with quiet dividers.
Flat article surfaces and restrained functional controls.
Responsive navigation and reading-focused text widths.
dos: Do use the editorial paper, ink, fog, rule, and teal tokens for the public-facing visual language.
Do keep article hierarchy clear with display headlines and monospaced metadata.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't assume the editorial palette changes with the semantic dark-theme tokens.
Don't substitute elevated card surfaces for the existing flat editorial article patterns without a deliberate design decision.
